**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement contains no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant. Searches for "solicit", "solicitation", "hire", "no-hire", "induce", "recruit", "entice" and "employ or engage" returned no hits.

The only employee-facing covenant is Section 6.15 (p0424), a mutual "No Other Compensation" representation confirming neither Party has paid the other's employees any consideration in connection with the transaction. That is an anti-bribery/anti-inducement style provision tied to deal consideration — it does not restrict AbbVie from soliciting, hiring or engaging Harpoon personnel, so it is not a disguised no-hire.

Result: no restrictive covenant binds us, which sits at the playbook's **preferred** position (no non-solicit on Customer).
